notes.title: SAD RPG Steam Early Access Update 12
notes.notes:
SAD RPG Steam Early Access Update 12 

Added and changed:

- the summer is coming so the snow has melted and the Christmas tree has been removed
- if you want to travel back in time to Christmas, use the weather station in your apartment and change the date, have a nice time travel!
- we have made minor changes to the code for future work
- updates and changes in the health center 
- new enemies added
- various minor bug fixes 


Happy playing,
Evil Indie Games
